title: Section 34 — Application for setting aside arbitral award

content.heading: Application for setting aside arbitral award
content.text: Recourse to a Court against an arbitral award may be made only by an application for setting aside such award in accordance with sub-section (2) and sub-section (3). The grounds include incapacity, invalid agreement, lack of proper notice, award beyond the scope of submission, defective composition or procedure, non-arbitrability, and conflict with the public policy of India as enacted. An application shall not be made after three months from the date on which the party making that application had received the award, with a further condonable period of thirty days but not thereafter. Read the official public-policy explanations.
